High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card with the text of [[Blizzard 1 (Decipher Errata 1998)]] and a gold ring “E” mark (Hoth, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Blizzard 1 _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1KuDGVmvC7HvlHu8ZxJaUmgydW09Or4wb/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Blizzard 1 _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,444 bytes, SHA-256 <code>cacebea3a0795968dd4b71a4836e6f9e74c2b4577da7ba342971f5364ef3e428</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.5, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

It is a fan re-set print, not a Decipher or Players Committee publication. It is listed in the Blizzard 1 versions list ([[Template:Card versions/Blizzard 1 (Hoth)]]) as “strangewayes print (fan re-set)” and is not shown on the version articles.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
